name: Vettweiß (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of green charged in the upper part with the shieldless municipal arms of Vettweiß, the Madonna in a radiant yellow sun above a lion.
history: By deed of the Minister of the Interior of North Rhine-Westphalia of 24 May 1967 the municipality of Vettweiß was granted the right to bear arms and a banner; the arms are modelled on an aldermen's seal of 1550.

features.role: Madonna in a radiant sun above a lion, from the municipal arms
